description.zh: 云电脑模板ID列表。可设置1\~100个。
description.en: The IDs of the cloud computer templates. You can specify 1 to 100 IDs.
The type of the cloud computer template.

description.zh: 是否查询云电脑规格的库存状态。
description.en: Specifies whether to query the inventory status of the cloud computer instance type.

description.zh: 云电脑规格包含的vCPU数量。
description.en: The number of vCPUs contained in the cloud computer instance type.
The instance family of the cloud computers.

description.zh: > 此参数暂未对外开放使用。
description.en: > This parameter is not available for public use.
Specifies whether the cloud computers in the template belong to a cloud computer pool.

description.zh: 云电脑规格包含的GPU个数。
description.en: The number of GPUs contained in the cloud computer instance type.
The GPU driver type.
The image IDs.

description.zh:
分页查询时，每页最大行数。

- 最大值：100
- 默认值：10
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

description.zh: 云电脑规格包含的内存大小。单位为GiB。
description.en: The memory size of the cloud computer instance type. Unit: GiB.
The token that is used to start the next query.
The type of the OS.
The protocol type.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [](t2167755.xdita#)operation to query the regions supported by Elastic Desktop Service (EDS).
The scenario to use the image.
The desktop template that is selected based on specific criteria.
The type of the session.

description.zh: 查询云电脑列表时是否返回多会话的云电脑模板。默认不返回。
description.en: Specifies whether to return multi-session cloud computer templates. Default value: false.
Specifies whether to enable disk encryption.

title.zh: 查询云电脑模板的详细信息
